full_prompt_en: A dramatic American comic-book illustration shows a colossal muscular fighter advancing over broken ground in an apocalyptic red landscape. He fills the center, one leg planted forward on a mound of black debris, fists lowered and shoulders spread wide. His charcoal-gray body and torn dark trousers are modeled with dense crosshatching and layered black shadows, so the near silhouette feels almost carved from ink. Several smaller figures stand farther back at either side, their scale making his mass more imposing. A huge snarling face intrudes from the upper right, cropped by the frame and partly swallowed by darkness. Behind the central fighter, a pale red circular glow sits amid whorls of fiery scarlet texture. Ruined structures, smoke, and tangled ground are suggested by jagged ink fragments rather than painstaking environmental detail. The palette is tightly restricted to black, gray, crimson, and hot coral red; bright red occupies the background while the foreground and central mass form a dark wedge. Sharp white flecks and thin red rim accents skim raised surfaces, but most illumination comes from the backlit red field. Deep shadows under limbs and rubble create strong volume, and short parallel ink strokes articulate the strained surfaces. The composition pushes a central vertical body toward the viewer while diagonal debris and peripheral figures lead inward. Large cropped forms heighten urgency and keep the panel crowded, forceful, and cinematic. Its graphic punch comes from extreme scale contrast, dense line texture, and an almost monochrome red-black collision.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅戏剧化美式漫画插画呈现巨型肌肉战士在末日般的红色地景里踏过破碎地面。他占据中央，一腿向前踩在黑色废墟堆上，双拳下垂、肩膀大幅张开。炭灰身体与破损暗裤以密集交叉排线和层叠黑影塑造，近处剪影仿佛从墨中凿出。几位更小的人物站在两侧远处，尺度差异令他的体量更骇人。一张巨大怒吼的面孔从右上方侵入，被画框截断，又部分沉进黑暗。中央战士身后，淡红圆形辉光坐在火焰般猩红纹理的旋涡中。毁坏建筑、烟气和纠结地面由锯齿状墨迹碎片暗示，而非细密描环境。调色严格限制在黑、灰、深红和炽热珊瑚红；明红占据背景，前景与中央体块形成暗楔。锐利白色碎点和细红轮廓光略擦过凸起表面，但主要照明来自背后红色场。肢体和瓦砾下的深影造出强烈体积，短平行墨线刻画绷紧表面。构图把中央竖直身体推向观者，斜向碎石与边缘人物引目入内。大型截断形体增强紧迫感，让画格拥挤、有力且有电影感。图像冲击力来自极端尺度对比、浓密线纹和近乎单色的红黑碰撞。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast comic illustration combines heavy black ink masses, dense crosshatching, and sharply modeled gray passages against an almost monochrome crimson field. Hot coral and pale red glows occupy broad background areas, while foreground planes collapse into jagged charcoal silhouettes. Short parallel strokes, torn edges, and clustered scratch lines make surfaces appear rough and tense. A backlit circular flare can sit behind the main dark mass, with sparse white flecks and narrow red rim accents picking out select raised planes. Strong foreshortened scale, large cropped peripheral forms, and diagonal debris-like marks drive the eye toward a central vertical weight. Smaller distant marks reinforce depth without competing with the main silhouette. Shadows are deep and abrupt; highlights are few and hard-edged. The image feels crowded and cinematic, yet its restricted palette keeps the action legible. Visible inking and rhythmic hatch density give the surface the physical energy of a printed graphic panel.
style_prompt_zh: 高对比漫画插画把沉重黑墨色块、密集交叉排线和锐利塑形的灰色层放在近乎单色的深红场前。炽热珊瑚红与浅红辉光占宽阔背景，前景平面则沉成锯齿状炭黑剪影。短平行笔、撕裂边缘和簇状抓痕让表面显得粗糙而紧绷。逆光圆辉可置于主要暗块之后，稀少白色碎点和狭窄红色轮廓强调部分凸起面。强烈透视尺度、大块边缘截断形体和斜向碎片笔痕把目光推向中央竖直重量。较小的远处笔痕加深空间而不与主剪影争夺。阴影深而突然，高光少且边缘坚硬。画面拥挤而具电影感，但受限调色仍让动作清晰。可见墨线和有节奏的排线密度赋予表面印刷图像画格般的身体能量。
theme_en: A colossal fighter advancing through a red comic-book apocalypse
theme_zh: 巨型战士在猩红漫画末日场景中前行
name: Mike Deodato
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
